verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus's own API docs confirm that it has an automations feature: an automation can be started for a specific contact. Nothing in the pack describes how automations are built or what they can contain. missing for 10: evidence of multi-step sequences, branching logic, delay steps, exit rules, welcome/onboarding/winback templates, a visual automation builder, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build multi-step lifecycle automations — welcome series, onboarding, winback — with branches, delays, and exit rules

citations.quote: Start an automation for a specific contact.
